svg.text: The pipeline, cycle by cycle (a real trace from the cycle-exact model)
A loop that sums three numbers: forwarding, a load stall, a predicted-taken branch, a flush when the loop exits. Caches off for clarity.

g.text: Six instructions in flight, one finishing per cycle when nothing is in the way.

Forwarding: DECODE needs a value that EXECUTE is computing right now. It is taken straight
from the ALU output at the end of this cycle, so nothing waits.
Forwarding: DECODE needs a value that EXECUTE is computing right now. It is taken straight
from the ALU output at the end of this cycle, so nothing waits.
LOAD_STALL: add needs t1, but the load only has it in MEMORY next cycle. DECODE and the
front end hold; a bubble goes into EXECUTE. Then the value is forwarded from MEMORY.
Forwarding from MEMORY: the loaded value reaches DECODE one stage later than an ALU result.
Six instructions in flight, one finishing per cycle when nothing is in the way.
FETCH2 redirect: predecode sees a branch the predictor calls taken, so FETCH1 jumps back to
the top of the loop. The instruction fetched behind it is squashed: 1 bubble.

FLUSH: the branch guessed "taken" but the loop is over. BranchControl squashes the 3 younger
instructions (red) and FETCH1 restarts at the right address: 3 bubbles.
